name: dev-productivity
description: Software product definition and solution-design workflows for discovery, modeling, research, prototyping, specifications, and work decomposition.

interface.shortDescription: Software product definition and solution design
interface.longDescription: Dev Productivity shapes software work before delivery through interviews, clarification, domain modeling, primary-source research, prototypes, specifications, and task decomposition. Handoffs, teaching, questionnaires, and agent-facing documentation support that collaborative design work and remain independently useful.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me define, research, prototype, specify, or decompose this software product work.
